note: The locale allowlist (issue 050). A locale exists here or it does not exist at all — selection may only name a key from this file, never a URL or a query parameter (the issue-041 rule). `files` is the set of domain files that locale actually ships: THE FILES THAT EXIST ARE THE SUPPORT YOU HAVE, and any key a locale does not carry falls back one hop to en-gb. `status` gates per locale, not globally, so a half-translated language can be visible and honestly marked instead of hiding behind a single SOON.
